:::{#exm-pos-agreement-harmonic}
#### Positive agreement of the COVID-19 test as a harmonic mean

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the estimated positive predictive value is $693 / 786$
and the estimated sensitivity is $693 / 700$
(@exm-agreement-test-measures).
@thm-pos-agreement-harmonic gives:

$$
\ba
p_{\text{pos}}
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{693 / 786} + \frac{1}{693 / 700}}
&& \text{(harmonic mean of the two estimates)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{786}{693} + \frac{1}{693 / 700}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{786}{693} + \frac{700}{693}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1{,}486}{693}}
&& \text{(add fractions with a common denominator)} \\
&= 2 \cd \frac{693}{1{,}486}
&& \text{(dividing by a fraction multiplies by its reciprocal)} \\
&= \frac{1{,}386}{1{,}486}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&\approx 0.933
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-pos-agreement-harmonic}

which matches @exm-positive-agreement.
The lower positive predictive value (about 0.88)
pulls the positive agreement down from the sensitivity (0.99),
as in @exm-harmonic-mean.

:::
